title: [ Open Source] music.lol Music Player & Visualizer
features:
An Open-Sourced Music Player + Visualizer with customization and inspiration from the osu! thing
-- the thumbnail doesnt go hard this time bc ai gives some bs
How to use:

Go to your executors workspace folder and go into

workspace\iamosulazer\Your playlist (or create a playlist of your own with atleast one song and optionally an image)
and put sound files in there then you will be able to play them in-game and with their playlist photos aswell.
on first run it will put bad apple in there bc peak

Complete feature list:

Circular visualizer
Local sound files support
Local playlist photos support
mobile + pc support
smooth ahh ui
customizable
save between sessions
open sourced

Settings:
